Diet therapy and all naturopathy meals

Naturopathy treatments as prescribed by your doctor
Cotton pyjama suits for your stay, and their laundry
Discharge summary and online follow-up consultations after you leave
excludes: Signature therapies beyond the {signature-therapies} each week

Care at an outside hospital, if needed

supplements.label: Extra bed or mattress
supplements.note: Only when a separate bed is added to the room.

supplements.label: Personal attendant (bystander)
supplements.note: The personal attendant is in addition to the 24-hour nursing care every guest receives.

postponement: A booking may be postponed once, free of charge, by written request received at least {noticeDays} days before the arrival date. Postponement is subject to availability.
The guest must confirm the new dates within {confirmWithinDays} days of the request. The new arrival date must fall within {newStayWithinMonths} months of the original arrival date.
Where the rate for the new dates is higher, the guest pays the difference. Where it is lower, the difference is not refunded.
A postponed booking cannot be changed again and is not refundable.
groupNote: For 10 or more rooms on the same dates, contact us for group rates.
publicNotes: Rates are per room, per night, and include all taxes.
Double occupancy applies only when both guests take the programme.
A companion staying in a separate room is charged separately. Our team confirms the amount.

The minimum stay is {minimum-stay}. Your doctor confirms the final length of stay based on your condition. If your doctor recommends a longer stay, extra nights are charged at the rates on this tariff.
bookingSteps: Fill in our online health assessment form.
Our doctors review it and may arrange a free online consultation.
Your doctor confirms whether the programme suits you and how long you should stay.
We send you an invoice, payable under the payment terms.
